bagPolicy.summary: LSU’s concert event page links its Geaux Safe bag guidance; the stadium’s clear-bag policy applies to concerts. Check the linked policy for approved dimensions and any event exceptions.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: For the March 2026 Zach Bryan concert, free parking was in the Levee, Hayfield and other designated lots; prepaid reserved passes cost $40–$50 and opened at noon. These arrangements were show-specific.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a specific rideshare pickup or drop-off point in its Zach Bryan concert guide.

concessions.summary: Inside Tiger Stadium, transactions for the Zach Bryan concert were cashless; cash-to-card machines were listed near Gate 30 and Gates 6 and 31. Other concerts may set different menus and payment procedures.

accessibility.summary: For the Zach Bryan concert, free accessible parking and shuttle service were provided in Lot 406 off Skip Bertman Drive; paid accessible spaces were available in Lot 401. A lactation room was near Section 106.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The official Zach Bryan concert guide states that fans may not leave Tiger Stadium and be readmitted.

ticketPickup.summary: For the March 2026 concert, will-call windows opened at 2 p.m. at the LSU Athletics Ticket Office on the first floor of the Athletics Administration Building. Later concert pickup times may differ.
